handback.title: Remove secrets before cutting run transcripts
handback.summary: Run transcripts cut tool text before removing secrets, so a cut token's start gets published.
handback.user_story: No part of a secret token ever shows in a published run transcript.

acceptance_criteria.text: A secret running across the cut of a tool's input shows none of its start in the transcript.
acceptance_criteria.words: cuts tool input and results to 2000 and 1500 characters before secrets are removed. A token cut in half no longer matches and its start gets published. Reproduced with a 40-character token. Remove secrets first, then cut.

edge_cases.case: Tool input longer than the cut is still cut after secrets are removed.

acceptance_criteria.text: A secret running across the cut of a tool's result shows none of its start in the transcript.
acceptance_criteria.words: cuts tool input and results to 2000 and 1500 characters before secrets are removed. A token cut in half no longer matches and its start gets published. Reproduced with a 40-character token. Remove secrets first, then cut.

edge_cases.case: A tool result longer than the cut is still cut after secrets are removed.
